title: Sao Paulo outreach — booth logistics & petty cash pocket
body:
Quick pocket notes for the Sao Paulo outreach trip (booth + 1-day meetup). This is a scratchpad — messy bits, receipts flow, and TODOs. Use for day-of handoff and reimbursement prep.

Day-of summary (minute-level):
- 06:00 alarm, chargers + backup battery in carry-on (label: CHG-MC).
- 07:30 meet drivers in hotel lobby (driver: Fernando, +55 11 98765-4321) — confirm car seat for stage kit.
- 09:00 venue arrival: load-in door B, ask for dolly (venue contact: Marina / +55 11 91234-5566).
- 09:30 quick booth check: table covers (x3), AV HDMI adapter, mic battery pack.
- 10:00 doors open — two staff on front (Priya, Liam), one floater for demos.

Petty cash & receipts:
- Float recommended: BRL 600 (breakdown: taxis BRL 200, food BRL 200, incidentals BRL 200). Change to USD on reimbursement form at 1 BRL = 0.19 USD (use current rate at time of submission).
- Receipt naming convention: YYYYMMDD_vendor_amount_BR (e.g., 20250912_uberride_45BR.jpg).
- Small receipts (taxis, vendor snacks): staple to small receipt sheet and photograph before attaching.

Vendor contacts + notes:
- Local AV: Copacabana Audio — contact Thiago +55 21 99876-3344. Leave 30-min buffer for mic checks. Rate note: they bill by half-day; push for hourly if only 2-3 mics.
- Caterer (light snacks): Sabor Express — Ana +55 11 95432-1122. Confirm vegetarian/vegan pack (label aisles).
- Print shop: Papel Rápido — same-day banners if needed (+55 11 98111-2233). Keep invoice for accounting.

Expense category mapping (quick):
- Travel: ACC-TVL
- Meals: ACC-MEAL
- Local transport: ACC-TRANS
- Booth materials: ACC-MKT
- AV: ACC-TECH

Reimbursement checklist (attach to Concur upload):
- Copy of vendor invoice (PDF or photo)
- Credit card statement line (if corporate card used)
- Signed petty cash log if float used (collect signatures from event lead)
- Exchange rate note and calculation if converting BRL to USD

Packing notes (tech & fragile):
- Tech bag: 2x MacBooks, 1x HDMI adapter kit (mini->HDMI, USB-C->Ethernet), dongle pouch, USB-C battery pack, labelled cables in zip bags.
- Booth materials: pop-up banner (x1), brochure stack (x200), lead capture tablet (tablet + stand), sticky pads + markers.
- Mark fragile case: "BOOTH - HANDLE WITH CARE" and keep with person.

Contingencies / quick fixes:
- If AV no-show: rent local Mics from Copacabana Audio on-site; escalate to events manager for approval.
- Lost receipts: get a signed note from vendor with amount + date + contact and attach to expense with explanation.
- Late baggage: hotel can store temp kit; call Fernando for urgent pickup.

Questions / open items:
- Confirm whether finance needs BRL bank transfer receipts for vendor invoices above BRL 1500. (Priya to check with finance).
- Are expense caps per person same as US per-diem? (flagged — need confirmation).

Slack preflight reminders (copy/paste):
- "Team — packing complete? Post photo of packed tech bag here by 20:00 local. Double-check chargers + dongles"
- "Reminder: name receipts as YYYYMMDD_vendor_amount_BR before uploading to Concur. See pocket doc."

Notes to self: take extra adhesive labels, masking tape, and a sharpie. Keep one local SIM in my wallet (TIM shop near Av. Paulista) with ~BRL 50 credit.

End of scratchpad. Convert to formal ops doc after the event and move invoices to Confluence page /events/sao-paulo-2025/finance.
